text:
mara: quick review: I'm prototyping a 'schema diff preview' inside run-history so users can see how an inline suggestion would alter the output. Sketch: tiny side-by-side diff, hover to highlight example output deltas. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example-diff (WIP)

olivia: nice. two constraints: keep collapsed rows very short, and don't push the log timestamp column off-screen.

leo: also: make sure the diff isn't overly noisy for small whitespace changes. we should normalize and show semantic edits only.

sam: From product POV, label the affordance clearly: 'Preview change' vs 'Apply change'. Users often think preview = save.

mara: agree, button copy matters. proposal: Preview change (secondary), Apply change (primary). Add keyboard shortcut P to toggle preview, Enter to apply when focused.

tia: Accessibility notes: when preview opens, announce via aria-live: 'Preview opened: 3 changes, 1 type change'. When preview closes (no apply), announce 'Preview closed, no changes applied'. If user applies, announce 'Change applied to run X'. All announcements should be polite.

leo: Good. For screen readers we should avoid complex SVG diff descriptions. Instead provide a condensed textual summary first and then a keyboard-accessible 'Read full diff' button that expands a text diff.

olivia: Design nit: the inline preview panel should use a subtle border and 8px vertical padding. In collapsed mode show a single-line summary: e.g. "Preview: param type -> string" with an icon.

sam: Edge case: if applying a suggestion would change the canonical saved schema for a run, we need an undo affordance and a small toast with 'Undo' for 10s. Also log an audit action.

mara: yes — no silent changes. Implementation note: do not mutate the stored run schema until Apply is clicked. Maintain a staged copy client-side, send PATCH /playground/runs/:id/stage-change -> {patch}. Apply will POST /playground/runs/:id/apply-change.

leo: dev note: server should return a minimal preview sample so we can render example output deltas without re-running heavy generation. maybe return changed tokens or a short summary. limit to 3 lines.

tia: Contrast check: preview badge background currently uses #F2F4F7 with text #6B7280 at 13px. That fails for small text. Use #111827 or increase font-weight/size. I'll attach WCAG examples in the a11y doc.

mara: UX question: do we show previews inline for every suggestion or only for suggestions that touch output-shaping fields (like response_format/schema)? My leaning: show when output shape or type changes, hide for trivial renames.

olivia: prefer heuristics: show for output-impacting diffs by default, but offer 'Show previews for all changes' toggle in settings.

sam: copy tweak: instead of 'staged changes' label use 'Pending changes' — clearer to non-devs.

leo: keyboard focus flow: tab into run item -> press P to open preview -> focus lands on 'Apply change' button -> pressing Escape closes preview and returns focus to run item. Make sure screen reader focus is consistent.

mara: good. I'll update the prototype with the keyboard flow.

a11y-bot: checklist generated: keyboard navigation, aria-live announcements, semantic diff fallback, contrast ratios, toast undo accessibility, SR read full diff button. Assigned to tia.

tia: I'll draft the checklist and run NVDA + VoiceOver passes. Also recommend we record a short screen-share test for handoff.

olivia: action items: mara update figma (padding/summary copy); leo + eng spec API preview payload + undo; sam update copy in product doc; tia produce a11y checklist and test script.

mara: scheduling: eng sync tomorrow 11am PT to review API contract. Thanks all. :sparkles:
